p: and leave but the sixth part: Or, destroy you with six plagues, as in Eze 38:22.
shalt fall upon the mountains of: Meaning that by the virtue of God's word the enemy will be destroyed wherever he assails his Church.
isles: That is, among all nations where the enemies of my people dwell, no matter how separate they seem.
it is come: That is, this plague is fully determined in my counsel and cannot be changed.

go forth: After this destruction the Church will have great peace and tranquillity and burn all their weapons because they will no more fear the enemies. This chiefly refers to the accomplishment of Christ's kingdom when by their head Christ all enemies will be overcome.
a place there of graves in: Which declares that the enemies will have a horrible fall.
noses of the travellers: For the stink of the carcasses.
And seven months shall the house: Meaning a long time.
land to bury with the travellers: Partly that the holy land should not be polluted and partly for the compassion that the children of God have even on their enemies.
gather yourselves on every side to: By which he signifies the horrible destruction that would come on the enemies of his Church.
their iniquity: The heathen will know that they did not overcome my people by their strength, neither yet by the weakness of my arm, but that this was for my people's sins.
